key_impacts: Severe social, economic and psychological damages reported
evidence_snippets: 17 January 1995: a Magnitude 7.9 earthquake shook the city of Kobe and adjoining areas in Hyogo.
Destroyed thousands of houses and left millions of people homeless.
missing_information: Specific adjoining affected areas beyond Kobe not named

evidence_snippets: The impact was visible in last year’s Niigata Earthquake, with magnitude 6.8.
Damages to buildings in Niigata were high.
The human toll—35 lives lost—was far less severe.
